name: JetBrains AI
summary: AI coding assistant and Junie agent in JetBrains IDEs.
description: JetBrains AI brings code completion, contextual chat, test and documentation generation to IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm. Junie, its coding agent, can carry out complete tasks in a project.

howToUse.title: Sign up on JetBrains AI
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Complétion de code dans les IDE JetBrains
Génération de tests et de documentation
summary_fr: Assistant de code IA et agent Junie dans les IDE JetBrains.
description_fr: JetBrains AI intègre aux IDE comme IntelliJ IDEA ou PyCharm la complétion de code, un chat contextuel, la génération de tests et de documentation. Junie, l'agent de code, peut mener des tâches complètes sur un projet.
